reference: Bash type/help metadata is checked against the documented static-builtin registration and the httpd_doc contract in the pinned source. Local multipart expectations come from the explicit fixture bytes and the documented field, delimiter, filename-basename, length, and return-value rules. No GNU CLI implements this HTTP server primitive, so socket operations are deferred rather than presented as parity.
coverage: Bash reports httpd as a builtin.
help httpd exposes documented listen, accept, reply, and part usage and behavior.
Safe local multipart parsing: named field selection, exact CRLF payload, filename basename, byte length, quoted boundary, default first filename, and missing-field behavior.
exclusions: No listen, accept, or reply operation is run because the user forbids network activity. Those behaviors remain DEFERRED for a disposable VM with isolated loopback or a reviewed socket mock.
No GNU command provides equivalent server-primitive behavior, so no synthetic parity oracle is used.
Request watchdog timing is not exercised; a future fixture needs a bounded client or deterministic socket and clock mock.

cases.purpose: Check the Bash type builtin reports the documented statically integrated httpd command as a builtin.
Check help httpd contains the command forms and core behavior promised by httpd_doc, using Bash's documented help interface.
cases.script:
doc=$(help httpd)
[[ $doc == *"httpd listen PORT [-a ADDR] -H VAR"* ]]
[[ $doc == *"httpd accept LFD -H CFD -m METHOD -p PATH -q QUERY -B BODYFILE"* ]]
[[ $doc == *"-t SECS: return 3 on timeout, nothing bound."* ]]
[[ $doc == *"httpd reply CFD [-s STATUS] [-t CONTENT_TYPE] [-f FILE]"* ]]
[[ $doc == *"httpd part BODYFILE -b BOUNDARY -o OUTFILE"* ]]
printf 'documented httpd help sections present\n'

cases.purpose: Extract one selected multipart field from a deterministic local fixture; verify exact CRLF payload, Windows-style filename basename, length binding, and the documented silent miss result without networking.
cases.script:
{
  printf '%s\r\n' '--BND' 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="other"' '' 'ignore'
  printf '%s\r\n' '--BND' 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="payload"; filename="C:\tmp\sample.txt"' 'Content-Type: text/plain' ''
  printf '%s' $'alpha\r\nomega'
  printf '\r\n--BND--\r\n'
} > body
httpd part body -b BND -o result -n payload -F file_name -l part_len
actual=$(<result)
[[ $actual == $'alpha\r\nomega' && $file_name == sample.txt && $part_len == 12 && -f result ]]
if httpd part body -b BND -o missing -n absent; then
  missing_status=0
else
  missing_status=$?
fi
[[ $missing_status == 1 && ! -e missing ]]
printf 'named multipart payload and miss behavior match the documented contract\n'
cases.stdout: named multipart payload and miss behavior match the documented contract

cases.purpose: Check the documented default selection of the first part with filename=, quoted-boundary handling, basename extraction, and exact payload length using a local fixture.
cases.script:
{
  printf '%s\r\n' '--BND' 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="note"' '' 'readme' '--BND' 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="C:\docs\first.bin"' '' 'upload-bytes' '--BND--' ''
} > body
httpd part body -b '"BND"' -o result -F file_name -l part_len
actual=$(<result)
[[ $actual == upload-bytes && $file_name == first.bin && $part_len == 12 && -f result ]]
printf 'default multipart filename selection matches the documented contract\n'
cases.stdout: default multipart filename selection matches the documented contract

cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM with an isolated loopback client/server fixture or an independently reviewed socket mock. The current task forbids network activity, so neither httpd listen nor accept is invoked.

cases.purpose: Verify malformed request handling and the documented 400, 413, and 431 refusals, including an oversized Content-Length rejected before a body is sent.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM or deterministic socket mock that can submit bounded raw requests and capture replies. The current task forbids network activity, so accept is not invoked.

cases.purpose: Verify reply emits byte-exact status, Content-Type, Content-Length, Connection: close, and file/stdin bodies, and closes the client descriptor.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM with a socket-pair fixture or a reviewed send/close syscall mock. No reply socket is created or used in this suite.

cases.purpose: Verify a partial request that stalls past the documented total request deadline receives 408 and leaves request variables unbound.
cases.reason: Requires a future disposable VM with a bounded loopback client and the dedicated short-timeout test build, or a deterministic socket/clock mock. No client connection or timeout operation is run here.

cases.purpose: Extract exact binary bytes with a trailing LF and verify output truncation and private 0600 permissions.
cases.script:
printf '%s\r\n' '--B' 'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="data"; filename="sub/blob"' '' > body
printf '\000A\377\n\r\n--B--\r\n' >> body
printf old > result
chmod 644 result
httpd part body -b B -o result -F filename -l length
[[ $filename == blob && $length == 4 ]]
printf '\000A\377\n' > expected
cmp result expected
mode=$(stat -c %a result)
[[ $mode == 600 ]]
printf 'binary payload and mode verified\n'

cases.purpose: An empty multipart input yields a silent miss and creates no result file.
cases.script:
: > body
if httpd part body -b B -o result -n absent; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
[[ ! -e result ]]
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
